2609.02480.title: PragAlign: Feedback-Guided Pragmatic Alignment for Controlled Synthetic Dialogue Generation
2609.02480.paper_summary: Synthetic dialogue generation can support research in privacy-restricted service settings, but generated conversations must preserve communicative intent, affective meaning, and natural dialogue flow. We introduce PragAlign, a feedback-guided framework for controlled synthetic dialogue generation conditioned on service context, target intent, and target emotion, with auxiliary trait-style controls. PragAlign uses a generate--evaluate--revise loop in which an LLM-based evaluator scores intent alignment, emotion alignment, coherence, fluency, and aggregate quality, then provides criterion-specific feedback for up to three refinement rounds. On 800 matched dialogue specifications, PragAlign achieves 99.50\% evaluator-defined acceptance, compared with 72.25\% for one-shot generation and 95.88\% for repeated generation without structured feedback. This indicates that repeated attempts account for much of the gain over one-shot generation, while structured feedback primarily improves last-mile multi-constraint satisfaction rather than broad average quality. Refinement gains are concentrated in emotion alignment, which is also the dominant failure mode in ablations. A separate human evaluation of 1,200 generated dialogues shows that intent expression and dialogue flow are highly recognizable to annotators, while emotion appropriateness is less stable and more subjective. These results support PragAlign as a quality-control framework for improving evaluator-defined communicative constraint satisfaction, while showing that affective realization and independent human-perceived quality remain open challenges.
2609.02480.paper_summary_zh: 合成對話生成可以支持隱私受限服務環境中的研究，但生成的對話必須保留交流意圖、情感意義和自然對話流。 我們介紹了PragAlign，一個基於反饋的框架，用於在服務上下文、目標意圖和目標情感的條件下進行受控的合成對話生成，並具有輔助的特徵風格控制。 PragAlign使用生成--評估--修訂循環，其中基於LLM的評估器對意圖對齊、情感對齊、一致性、流暢性和整體質量進行評分，然後提供特定標準的反饋，最多進行三輪改進。在800個匹配的對話規範上，PragAlign達到了99.50\%的評估器定義接受率，而一次性生成為72.25\%，未經結構化反饋的重複生成為95.88\%。這表明重複嘗試在一次性生成的基礎上獲得了大部分增益，而結構化反饋主要改善了最後一公里的多約束滿足，而不是廣泛的平均質量。改進的增益集中在情感對齊上，這也是消融測試中的主要失敗模式。對1200個生成對話的單獨人類評估顯示，意圖表達和對話流對標註者來說是高度可識別的，而情感適當性則不太穩定且更具主觀性。這些結果支持PragAlign作為一個質量控制框架，以改善評估器定義的交流約束滿足，同時顯示情感實現和獨立人類感知的質量仍然是開放的挑戰。
